field_changes.old: Editing your Adaptive Plan just got smoother! Elite members now see instant confirmation whenever you swap, add, or delete exercises — whether you're mid-workout or wrapping up on the Workout Complete screen. Changes come with a built-in cooldown to keep your plan feeling intentional. Post-workout summary cards also got a polish pass on volume display, plus a handful of reliability fixes.
field_changes.new: Handful of bug fixes and reliability improvements.
